source.notes: 털뭉치 공방, a felt doll workshop (fictional)
Korean OFL fonts, cut to the characters the reel shows

rationale.palette: A workbench: a green cutting mat #2F7D5B with a pale grid on a wooden table #8A6A4A; felt in bear brown #A8754F, cream, pink #F2A6B3, ginger #E8A15A and off-white; cream thread #FFF4E0 for stitches, red yarn #E8574F, wooden and dark buttons; paper labels #FFF8EA with rose stitching.
rationale.type: Gamja Flower, a soft Korean handwriting, written on paper labels with a stitched border.
rationale.motion: Stop motion at 8 frames a second: the scenes step their time, the camera shifts a few pixels and the exposure flickers from frame to frame, pieces land rather than glide, a stitch appears per beat, the bear waves in four poses.
rationale.sound: Lofi at 96 BPM in D major (6 bars in 15 s, 12 in 30 s), e-piano and soft swing drums; organic SFX: snips and taps for each piece and stitch.
rationale.visuals: All code: felt fills (a colour dusted with short fibres in two shades and a fuzzy edge), dashed thread stitches, buttons with thread crosses, a needle with yarn, a cutting mat with a grid and numbers, paper labels with torn edges.
